1.translation: To destroy the dynasties of the demons, the Lord tricked Pūtanā into becoming a child. While breastfeeding him, he prepared the sacrifice of life with his life.* He threw the cart up into the sky and threw the grass down. In the seventh incarnation, Lord Kṛṣṇa plays with Him, showing Him the universe. He is full of the joy of floating in the sea of nectar of the black child. Again, the king is pleased to inquire about the same thing.* Yena Yena, it is. The activities of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, even in His incarnations as a fish, are always pleasing to our ears and pleasing to our minds.
